construct.unit: lowercase NFKC-normalized ASCII alphabetic surface token mapped to one or more NGSL head lemmas
construct.population_or_exposure_claim: membership in the NGSL 1.2 research-form inventory at an explicitly selected headword-rank cutoff

source.composite_sha256_formula: SHA-256(stats bytes + NUL byte + research-form bytes)

corpus_design.sampling_frame: not applicable to this derived ranked lexical inventory
corpus_design.balancing_or_weighting: source SFI rank retained; source-corpus construction is documented by NGSL
known_biases: research forms deliberately disregard meaning sense
generated possible forms include rare and contraction-fragment strings

processing.input_tokenizer_mapping: NFKC-normalize input, then recognize whole ASCII alphabetic tokens; apostrophes and hyphens are boundaries
processing.normalization: ASCII lowercase; seven hyphenated source variants excluded because unhyphenated variants are also supplied
processing.lemmatization: no runtime lemmatizer; exact source-supplied form-to-head mapping
processing.word_family_policy: NGSL research-form grouping, not a Nation Level 6 word family
processing.sense_mapping_policy: none; source explicitly collapses meaning senses

table.format: JSON; compact array rows nested in this manifest
table.duplicate_key_rule: one surface row; retain multiple head mappings for the five source-identified homographs

measurement.numerator_definition: profile-tokenized input tokens with at least one candidate NGSL head rank at or below the selected cutoff; all candidate mappings remain visible
measurement.denominator_definition: all profile-tokenized input tokens in the declared text
measurement.frequency_or_rank_formula: retain source SFI Rank of the mapped head lemma; no runtime frequency is inferred for a surface form
measurement.missing_item_policy: retain source-listed forms above the cutoff as beyond_cutoff and absent forms as unmatched
measurement.zero_denominator_policy: value is null; preserve numerator and denominator

rights.required_attribution: New General Service List 1.2 by Browne, Culligan, and Phillips; modified ASCII browser projection

validation.browser_size_or_latency_evidence: not yet measured in a real browser
validation.removal_or_replacement_procedure: delete this profile, notice, fetch/use/tests, and NGSL claims; never relabel a cutoff as a Nation word-family level
